label: Treasure Vault
description: Hoard interiors — treasure-filled spaces built for reflected light. Tagged 'interior' so open-sky templates can filter them out.

items.name: mountain-vault
items.text: A vault hollowed from the mountain's heart, coin-drifts rising in dunes between basalt pillars, the ceiling lost beyond the reach of any light.

items.name: sunken-treasury
items.text: A flooded cathedral treasury, gold blurring and shimmering under a meter of still clear water, columns climbing out of the flood into dark air.

items.name: counting-hall
items.text: A dwarven counting-hall where the treasure is sorted with terrible neatness — coin in graded bins, ingots stacked in courses, beam-scales at rest beside one open ledger.

items.name: shipwreck-hold
items.text: The split hold of an ancient shipwreck beached deep inside a sea-cave, treasure spilled down the tilted deck between barnacled ribs, salt crystals glittering on every chest.

items.name: barrow-treasury
items.text: A king's barrow chamber, grave-gold laid out in strict ceremony — torcs on stone shelves, a chariot's bronze fittings, amber beads in spirals nobody has disturbed.

items.name: tower-strongroom
items.text: A wizard tower's strongroom, artifacts spaced on velvet pedestals under glass bells, thin chains of warding script strung from wall to wall between them.

items.name: reliquary-crypt
items.text: A reliquary crypt beneath a ruined abbey, hammered gold masks and jeweled caskets crowded along stone shelving, incense ash still velvet on the floor.

items.name: glacier-cache
items.text: A hoard sealed inside a glacier crevasse, coins and crowns suspended at every depth in blue ice, the walls bending each glint into slow curves.
